blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Seventy-three wanted persons facing various charges were arrested in a weeklong police sweep across Soccsksargen (Region 12), authorities said on Wednesday. Police conducted the simultaneous law enforcement operations from October 26 to November 1, 2026. Brig. Gen. Alan Manibog, Police Regional Office (PRO-12) regional director, said the arrested individuals include 51 listed under the “wanted person” category and the rest as “other wanted persons.” READ: 4 Eastern Visayas most wanted suspects arrested in Undas ops The Cotabato Police Provincial Office arrested 21 wanted individuals, followed by the General Santos City Police Office with 14.
